billingModels.label: Annual upfront subscription
billingModels.cashTiming: Collected at the start of each paid year.
billingModels.revenueRecognition: Straight-line over 12 months; deferred revenue carried for the unearned part.

billingModels.label: Monthly per-vessel subscription
billingModels.cashTiming: Collected monthly in arrears/advance at the start of the month.

cohortAssumptions.note: Every rate is an ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIO ASSUMPTION. CHURN_VALIDATED = false, RENEWAL_RATE_VALIDATED = false, ACTIVATION_VALIDATED = false.

sharedEntitlements.notes: NAV and WEATHER share one chart/weather data-licence entitlement ledger. The licence cost is charged at most once per licensed account and is UNKNOWN.

paymentProcessing.notes: Published EEA card rate; not a negotiated merchant rate. App-store commission covers its own transaction.

inactiveAccountPolicy.notes: No provider has confirmed that a suspended SIM or dormant account is free.

deferredRevenuePolicy.notes: No refund-on-churn right is assumed; the treatment is a scenario assumption, not a contract term.
